requirements.statement: A household member can sign in securely so only the two household members can access the data

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor cannot view household expense data
A household member can sign in and reach the application

requirements.statement: A household member can add a daily expense with an amount, category, date, and optional note

criteria.must: Submitting a new expense with amount, category, and date creates it
An expense can be created without a note
Submitting an expense without a required field (amount, category, or date) is rejected

requirements.statement: Both household members see the full shared list of expenses logged by either of them

criteria.must: An expense logged by one household member appears in the list the other household member sees

requirements.statement: Either household member can edit or delete any expense, regardless of who logged it

criteria.must: A household member can edit an expense logged by the other household member
A household member can delete an expense logged by the other household member

requirements.statement: Either household member can create, edit, and delete expense categories

criteria.must: A household member can create a new expense category
A household member can edit an existing category's name
A household member can delete a category

requirements.statement: A household member can view total expenditures for today, this week, and this month

criteria.must: The dashboard shows a total for today that reflects logged expenses dated today
The dashboard shows a total for the current week that reflects logged expenses within that week
The dashboard shows a total for the current month that reflects logged expenses within that month

requirements.statement: A household member can see the total spent per category

criteria.must: Each category shows a total that reflects the sum of expenses logged against it

requirements.statement: A household member can set a spending limit for each category

criteria.must: A household member can set a limit amount when creating a category
A household member can change an existing category's limit

requirements.statement: A household member sees when a category is approaching or has exceeded its limit

criteria.must: A category whose spend is within its limit shows an ok/on-track indicator
A category whose spend has exceeded its limit shows an exceeded indicator
The limit indicator is shown in-app only, with no email, SMS, or push notification sent
